newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow to moderate in the Panhandle area on Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady and feedlots reported light inquiry from buyers.
WK to date - 110,300 Last week - 78,700 Year Ago - 24,400
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 61.00. Carcass Basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 98.50.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 61.00-61.50. Carcass Basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1150 lbs 97.50-98.50. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 60.00.
Sales reported on 5,900 slaughter steers and 5,300 heifers; 110,300 head confirmed for week to date which includes 27,800 formulated and 100 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
